videoTitle: Legal Documents Won't Keep You Safe When You're 85—Here's What Will
videoDescription: You've been told to get your power of attorney and advance directive in order. But those only answer who decides—not who shows up. If you're aging without kids or caring for a disabled dependent, there's a second layer of planning most people miss. Learn what it is at mindtivate.com
script: Everyone says get your power of attorney and advance directive. But here's what they don't tell you: those documents answer who decides, not who shows up. When you're 85 and need someone to actually drive you to appointments or notice when things aren't okay...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
thumbnailConcept: A close-up, high-contrast shot of an elderly person sitting alone at a kitchen table, their weathered hands resting anxiously on a stack of official-looking legal documents with blue notary seals, as they look toward a window with a quiet, worried expression of solitude.
